title: Database connection pool exhaustion
description: Payment API requests started failing with database connection timeout errors during peak traffic. The connection pool reached its maximum configured limit. Several application requests held connections longer than expected.
root_cause: Database connections were not released promptly because of improperly managed connection lifetimes and long-running database transactions.
remediation: Ensure connections are disposed correctly, optimize long-running queries, configure connection pool limits appropriately, and introduce database connection monitoring.

title: Application memory leak
description: Customer API memory consumption increased continuously over several hours. Eventually the application container exceeded its memory limit and restarted. Garbage collection did not recover the expected memory.
root_cause: Application objects were retained by an unbounded in-memory cache and event subscriptions were not released.
remediation: Implement bounded caching, unsubscribe unused event handlers, profile memory allocations, and configure container memory alerts.

title: High CPU utilization
description: Order processing latency increased significantly. CPU utilization remained above 95 percent across application instances. Request queues started growing and users experienced slow responses.
root_cause: An inefficient data-processing loop caused excessive CPU consumption, amplified by concurrent request processing.
remediation: Optimize CPU-intensive code, introduce bounded concurrency, use asynchronous processing where appropriate, and implement CPU utilization alerts.

title: Database query latency
description: Payment processing slowed down after a database deployment. SQL queries began taking several seconds, increasing API response times and creating a backlog of pending payment requests.
root_cause: A frequently executed query performed a full table scan because the required database index was missing.
remediation: Review query execution plans, add appropriate indexes, optimize SQL queries, and monitor database query latency.
